warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.desc: Tank & displacement. Broken Seal grants extra Barrier; Shove knocks foes into chasms.

mage.name: Mage
mage.unlock: Defeat Goo (Sewers boss) with any hero.
mage.desc: Zone control. The Mage's Staff fires its imbued wand as a bolt that ignores DR.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.unlock: Reach floor 4 of the Sewers with any hero.
rogue.desc: Stealth & assassination. Cloak of Shadows hides you for 2 ticks: enemies lose track and your next hit is a Surprise (dagger x2).

huntress.name: Huntress
huntress.unlock: Brew 5 potions at the Alchemy Pot.
huntress.desc: Geometry & overwatch. The Spirit Bow fires unlimited arrows at any enemy in line of sight (DR applies; Surprise from cover).
